description: Knowledge-base guardrails: kb check on the pages the agent changes, and a log.md entry for knowledge edits.

hooks.command: uv run --quiet python -m kbtools.hooks pre-tool --agent codex || true
hooks.commandWindows: uv run --quiet python -m kbtools.hooks pre-tool --agent codex

hooks.command: uv run --quiet python -m kbtools.hooks post-tool --agent codex || true
hooks.commandWindows: uv run --quiet python -m kbtools.hooks post-tool --agent codex

hooks.command: uv run --quiet python -m kbtools.hooks stop --agent codex
